how_to_use: Certificates of Analysis. Only entries with published set to true render on the site. Add a batch: create an entry with the cut, the batch code printed on the jar label, the COA date, and either a file (a PDF committed under coa/files/) or a url (the lab's public result page). Flip published to true when the COA is cleared for release. After editing, run: node tools/generate-coas.mjs

fields.published: true renders on the site, false is staged and hidden
fields.cut: must match a cut name in brand-tokens.json
fields.collection: firstWater or baseCamp (controls the accent color)
fields.batch: the batch/lot code printed on the jar label
fields.file: path to a PDF under coa/files/, e.g. files/GH1-SGPR-202605-RO1.pdf (leave blank if using url)
fields.url: public lab result page, opens in a new tab (leave blank if using file)
